name: Time is Money Wall Art Frame – Inch Wooden Sticky Tile with Watch & Dollar Design, Self-Adhesive Home Decor
description: Add a touch of luxury and motivation to your home or office with the “Time is Money” Wall Art Frame. Designed with a bold watch and dollar-themed artwork, this frame serves as both stylish décor and a daily reminder of success, ambition, and productivity. Crafted from high-quality wooden sticky tiles, it ensures durability and a premium finish that blends seamlessly with modern interiors. Measuring 8x11 and 12x16 inches, it is the perfect size to complement any wall without overwhelming your space.The frame comes with strong self-adhesive sticky tape, making installation quick and hassle-free – no drilling or nails required. Simply peel, stick, and transform your wall within minutes. Ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or study spaces, this wall art is not just decorative but also inspirational, creating an elegant atmosphere that reflects both style and motivation.
